spawn.name: Spawn
spawn.description: A safe camp with a cold fire pit. Paths lead out in every direction.

forest.name: Forest
forest.description: Quiet trees and fallen branches. Good for wood and the odd healing herb, and nothing bites.

jungle.name: Jungle
jungle.description: Dense leaves and animal tracks. There is wood and herbs here, and things that hunt back.

mines.name: Mines
mines.description: Dark tunnels with stone, iron ore, and the odd vein of gold. A narrow shaft drops into the deep mine.

deep_mine.name: Deep Mine
deep_mine.description: A cramped dungeon below the mines. Crystal glints in the walls, and something heavy moves in the dark.

volcano.name: Volcano
volcano.description: A scorched peak wreathed in ash. The ground is hot underfoot and the air smells of sulfur.

shadow_ruins.name: Shadow Ruins
shadow_ruins.description: The skeleton of an ancient city swallowed by darkness. Nothing living should be here.
